name: Jute Design Resource Centre Scheme
benefit:
- Provides up to 2 free designs per unit per quarter, with the cost of raw materials and accessories borne by the National Jute Board on an actual basis.
- Offers an unlimited number of designs on a First-In-First-Out basis under the cost-sharing model, where the design ideas and making charges are provided free of cost by the Jute Design Resource Centre.
- Grants the exporter or manufacturer the
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a Jute Artisan, a Micro Small and Medium Enterprise unit, an Exporter, a Women Self Help Group, or a Jute Raw Material Centre & Production Centre trained beneficiary. - The applicant must provide a formal request format for the sharing of jute bag designs developed and stored by the Jute Design Resource Centre. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must maintain confidentiality regarding the technical and design specification sheets provided for trademarked jute products. - The applicant must bear the full cost of trademark registration if they plan to obtain a trademark for the newly developed product. - The applicant must share the cost of raw materials and accessories used for developing the jute designer bags if applying under the cost-sharing basis.
